description: Utility functions for throughput data processing, including data rate formatting, calculation, chart data preparation, and unit conversions.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts bytes per second to a human-readable data rate with appropriate units.

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates current data rate from cumulative byte counts, handling counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into HH:MM:SS string.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares labels and datasets for throughput chart visualization from time series data.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Determines the appropriate unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for chart y-axis based on data rates.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts data rate in bytes per second to a specified unit for display.
